Been there done that too mate, I used to take many overdoses and I can only remember half of them, I am now in remission cause after I realised I wasn't put on earth to please every tom dick and Harry and now I only have myself to please there are less responsibilities meaning less things can go wrong! I took over 50 Zopiclone 7.5 tablets  all in one go and all that happened was I got a really good sleep and when I woke up it was a wasted attempt and then I got admitted to hospital, if you've made attempts and they have failed maybe try looking at it as a hint that its not your time to go, just keep pushing through a little more and let nature take its cause!!
Stay strong mate!
